reason: A DeepSeek Harness bundle for configuring, enabling, monitoring, and inventorying MCP servers through Web Settings, including stdio and Streamable HTTP connections.

summaries.zh: 通过 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置配置、启用、监控和查看 MCP 服务器，包括 stdio 与 Streamable HTTP 连接。
summaries.en: Manage, enable, monitor, and inventory stdio and Streamable HTTP MCP servers through DeepSeek Harness Web Settings.

capabilities: Manages MCP server configuration in the mcp.servers settings namespace
Starts and stops MCP client processes or connections for enabled servers
Supports stdio and Streamable HTTP MCP servers
Exposes a read-only MCP server inventory
Provides Web Settings forms, JSON editing, enable toggles, status polling, and tool counts
Uses credential references for HTTP authorization and stdio environment variables
